atoms.rule: Every handoff starts with the four-line attribution header.
atoms.why: A handoff without an author, session, task, and scope cannot be trusted or resumed.

fixtures.green:
Agent: codex
Chat/session: X-1 | y
Task: X-1 | t
Claim/scope: task:X-1

atoms.rule: Every handoff ends with a literal next command.
atoms.why: The receiving agent should be able to act without re-deriving the plan.

atoms.rule: AGENTS.md always tells agents that a live claim by the other agent is do-not-touch.
atoms.why: This is the one rule that keeps two agents from colliding. It must never be edited out.

atoms.rule: AGENTS.md always forbids editing .taos state files by hand.
atoms.why: Hand-edited state is how phantom tasks and drift appear.
